problem.symptom_2: RL1 trap refusal 13/15 (redline_20261124_232015) vs 15/15 (redline_20261124_233521) with identical config, no concurrency

root_cause.primary: LlmClient.complete() created a brand-new httpx.Client per call -> fresh TCP+TLS handshake on every generation AND NLI judge call; third-party SLB intermittently terminates the handshake with SSL EOF. No retry existed: every transient EOF became fallback(model_timeout).

rl1_flip_detail.change: reject_reason model_timeout -> no_evidence; gate1 pass -> reject_none; trap_safe False -> True
rl1_flip_detail.conclusion: RL1 divergence is 100% driven by gateway availability, NOT by gate/threshold/golden changes.

ruled_out.connection_pool_stale_reuse: No pool existed — a new client was constructed per call; pooled keep-alive REDUCED failures 5/30 -> 1/30.
ruled_out.eval_concurrency: Eval ran serially with no concurrent jobs; qa_budget_s is stored but not enforced as a hard cutoff.
ruled_out.qa_budget_30s: 20/21 failures completed in 1.3-12.7s (SSL EOF), only 1 was a real 30s timeout.
ruled_out.thresholds_or_golden: top1 identical across the two divergent rounds; 0.20/0.40 unchanged; golden unchanged.

fix.shared_keepalive_pool: httpx.Client keyed by (base_url, api_key, timeout), max_keepalive_connections=8, keepalive_expiry=30s; shared by generation and judge clients.

bounded_retry.retry_only: transient GenerationUnavailable (SSL EOF / timeout / 5xx / empty response)

verification.intermediate_finding: At 4 attempts / 30s budget, one cold first call (B01) failed 4 consecutive SSL EOFs during a ~20s SLB outage window -> budget raised to 6 attempts / 45s.

impact_on_eval_conclusions.publishability: STILL NOT_PUBLISHABLE — this task fixes stability only; coverage remains ~2/35 (5.7%). Over-refusal (20 draft_status) is owned by backend follow-up t_e7b858e4; threshold recalibration by data-analyst.
impact_on_eval_conclusions.what_changed: Red-line verdicts are now reproducible: the 13/15 FAIL was an infrastructure artifact, not a real gate regression. Single-round PASS can now be trusted as a gate signal for RL1.
impact_on_eval_conclusions.what_did_not_change: Retrieval, gate thresholds 0.20/0.40, golden set, and the 26/35 generation-layer blocks are untouched.
impact_on_eval_conclusions.residual_risk: If the SLB outage exceeds 45s or 6 attempts, fallback(model_timeout) still occurs; it is logged via llm_retry and remains fail-closed (no unverified answer is emitted).

rollback.steps: Set LLM_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 and remove the shared pool (restore old `with httpx.Client(...)` block), then `docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d api`.
rollback.effect: Restores the exact pre-fix behavior; eval results become non-reproducible again (13/15 <-> 15/15).
